_**User (2026-07-10 20:08:28Z)**_

How will these changes affect the text boxes located on the Add Series and Edit Series text boxes?

---

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

Only the Description field behavior changes, and it changes in both dialogs because they share the same form component.

- Both Add Series and Edit Series use [apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/general/SeriesEditControls.tsx](apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/general/SeriesEditControls.tsx), so the Description input in both places will become a multiline markdown-friendly box instead of a single-line input.
- Title, Alt 1, Alt 2, Authors, Artists, Tags, Language, and Status inputs stay the same in both dialogs.
- Existing plain text descriptions continue to work exactly as before; users can keep typing plain text if they do not want formatting.
- Saved value is still a string in the same field, so Add/Edit save flow and backup/restore behavior remain compatible.

Where this is wired:
- Add dialog uses the shared controls in [apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/search/AddSeriesModal.tsx](apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/search/AddSeriesModal.tsx)
- Edit dialog uses the shared controls in [apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/EditSeriesModal.tsx](apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/EditSeriesModal.tsx)

If you want, I can refine the plan with exact UX details for that Description box, like placeholder examples, markdown cheat hint, and optional Preview toggle.
